limitations: New stationary medians were higher; additional HUD telemetry, asynchronous material work and unlocked clocks/scheduling prevent isolating a frame-mapping tax or asserting a speedup.
Uniform flight spin does not implement gravity-harmonic tilt/prime-meridian frames or exact tidal-lock libration; no physical laws or authoritative clock changed.
Old survey/controller/ECS pose inputs retain f32 local offsets/rotations; body/rebase geometry is f64, not a full controller port.
No multi-object scene, spacecraft/station rendering, production effects/UI/network lifecycle or FastRT acceleration-structure parity claim.
Shading blur/coarse relief/thin dark artifacts remain visually unaccepted. Motion illumination has no atmosphere/eclipses/shadows or full night-side rendering.
